_doc: tools/plan_streetlights.py (ledger 0070 D1): the engine draft's lamp posts. lampheads = the draft heads (local x E, y up, z N; the arm tip ARM_M road-ward of the post, HEAD_OVER_GROUND_M over the draft ground) that tools/author_lamps_blend.py stands scenery.streetlights.model on; lamps = the same posts with their base, road-ward unit, station and side; skipped = every station with no post, and why.

seat_check.rule: |built ground - pole base| <= 1.0 m after the author stage; the model's footing (pole_bury_m) is by design and never counted

provenance.road_datum: head y - 8.944 m (ledger 0043: the 2026-10 light stood 6.94 m over the nearest road vertex, 2.004 m under the recorded head)
provenance.lens_offset_frame: per lamp: road_ward = head -> nearest centreline point (horizontal), up = +y; from the 2026-10 lamp's LIGHTS marker centroid (street_lamp_2026_10) to this lens centroid. ext_config [LIGHT_N] POSITION = lens centroid - 0.15 m y, so each light moves by the same offset
